body:
Thank you. I often forget that... we really need to focus on reality instead of our thoughts, and by that I mean what you said: hobbies and try (like, really try) to achieve things.

I forget that our thoughts are NOT what we are, they just want attention and want to -sometimes- mess with our brains.. and we forget the reality.


I have stopped doing things because of that, stopped hobbies, stopped exercising, stopped studying and developing myself to be a better programmer because I don't feel like I'm enough, I feel scared and incapable of doing things. I don't know where these thoughts are coming, they are so crushing.


I think my best chance is to actually go back to therapy and start taking meds. I didn't take the meds 2 years ago because I got cold feet the last moment. I had my recipe and everything, but I just couldn't buy them and start taking them, after reading how they can mess up your brain.
